candidates.change_summary: Change the OR condition to include ERC1155MetadataURI interface, making supportsInterface return true for that interface id as well.
Remove checking for IERC1155 and only defer to parent ERC165, causing some interface ids to now return false.
Invert the comparison for IERC1155 to make supportsInterface return false when queried for IERC1155, changing observable response.
Change the zero-address check to allow the zero address by removing the require, so balanceOf returns stored mapping value for address(0) instead of reverting.
Invert the zero-address check to require account == address(0), causing balanceOf to revert for any non-zero address and return stored value for zero address only.
Return zero for any queried account regardless of stored balance by replacing body with constant 0 return.
Swap the id and account access to return balances[account][id] (nonsensical mapping order) which will compile but yield different values.
